tasoma-extract.name: Tasoma Extract
tasoma-extract.description:
Duviri citizens plagued by nightmares seek Tasoma, because its stalks can be crushed to create juice that invites pleasant dreams. Unfortunately, it is difficult to forage Tasoma as it only grows in caves.

Location: Duviri

tasoma-spore.name: Tasoma Spore
tasoma-spore.description: A Tasoma fungal spore, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.

tear-azurite.name: Tear Azurite
tear-azurite.description:
Polished and cut to perfection.

Blueprint sold by Old Man Suumbaat in Cetus on Earth.

technocyte-coda-token.name: Technocyte Coda Token
technocyte-coda-token.description: A token symbolizing a converted Technocyte Coda. Can be traded to other players for control of said Technocyte Coda.

techrot-chitin.name: Techrot Chitin
techrot-chitin.description:
This twisted husk barely resembles the electronic device it once was, consumed and reshaped by the Techrot’s relentless spread.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)

techrot-motherboard.name: Techrot Motherboard
techrot-motherboard.description:
This motherboard likely served as a nerve center, facilitating the Techrot's communication network.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)

tempered-bapholite.name: Tempered Bapholite
tempered-bapholite.description:
Fused with its inert Infested tendrils into a durable alloy.

Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.

temporal-dust.name: Temporal Dust
temporal-dust.description:
The dust of decayed universes, rich in entropy. Entrati's research postulates it as the animating agent of the nightmarish Murmur.

Obtained from Murmur in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)

tepa-nodule.name: Tepa Nodule
tepa-nodule.description:
The iridescent nodules on these plants glow brightly in cold environments.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus

tertium.name: Tertium
tertium.description:
Its power lies in its potential.

Location: Duviri

thaumic-distillate.name: Thaumic Distillate
thaumic-distillate.description:
Thaumica reduced to its most durable, workable elements.

Blueprint sold by Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.

thaumica.name: Thaumica
thaumica.description:
Can be molded by the Infestation but remains resistant to it.

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Yellow Mining Lesions, Requiem Obelisks, and Spitia Infested Cysts.

the-countessa-comic.name: The Countessa Comic
the-countessa-comic.description:
The Countessa isn't just an icon—she's a hero! Issues from this cult classic comic series are sought after by subculture enthusiasts who know the value of a strong and stylish protagonist. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)

thermal-sludge.name: Thermal Sludge
thermal-sludge.description:
A by-product from the Weeping Towers terraforming processes.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus

thrax-plasm.name: Thrax Plasm
thrax-plasm.description:
Found in the remnants of Thrax Void manifestations, this plasm has several surprisingly practical applications.

Location: Zariman

thyst.name: Thyst
thyst.description:
A beautiful and iridescent red shard.

Location: Orb Vallis (Venus) from Blue Mining Veins and the Exploiter Orb. This Rare Gem can only be mined by the Advanced Nosam Cutter or Sunpoint Plasma Drill.

tiametrite.name: Tiametrite
tiametrite.description:
Infested neurotransmitters condensed under pressure.

Location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Blue Mining Lesions, Sagiant Entrati Caskets, and Bonus Vaults in Isolation Vault Bounties.

ticor-plate.name: Ticor Plate
ticor-plate.description:
High-density alloy armor plating used in the construction of offensive spacecraft.

Location: Railjack Missions

titanium.name: Titanium
titanium.description:
This highly malleable metal was exploited in great quantities by the Orokin and can now only be found within space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions

trachons.name: Trachons
trachons.description: An organ found on Infested Ships believed to facilitate communication within the Infested Hivemind.

training-debt-bond.name: Training Debt-Bond
training-debt-bond.description:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

travocyte-alloy.name: Travocyte Alloy
travocyte-alloy.description:
A compound formed from Travoride.

Blueprint sold by Smokefinger in Fortuna on Venus.

travoride.name: Travoride
travoride.description:
A mineral hardened by the crushing pressure of the Venusian atmosphere.

Location: Orb Vallis (Venus) from Red Mining Veins and Resource Containers

trembera-essence.name: Trembera Essence
trembera-essence.description: A highly purified mineral compound prized for its strength, resiliency, and resistance to heat. Widely used in the construction of Tenno relays.
